-- test: logger list --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger
-- expect:regex --
LOGGER\s+LEVEL
-- expect:regex --
ROOT\s+INFO
-- expect:regex --
com\.example\.testapp\s+INFO
-- expect:regex --
org\.apache\.catalina\.startup\.DigesterFactory\s+ERROR
-- expect:regex --
org\.springframework\.web\s+INFO


-- test: logger set level and verify --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger com.example.testapp DEBUG
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger
-- expect:regex --
LOGGER\s+LEVEL
-- expect:regex --
com\.example\.testapp\s+DEBUG
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger com.example.testapp INFO
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger
-- expect:regex --
com\.example\.testapp\s+INFO


-- test: logger prefix filter with footer after table --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger org.springframework
-- expect:regex --
LOGGER\s+LEVEL
-- expect:regex --
org\.springframework\.web\s+INFO
-- expect:not --
ROOT
-- expect:regex --
(?s)org\.springframework\.web.*non-matching loggers omitted


-- test: loggers alias --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} loggers
-- expect:regex --
LOGGER\s+LEVEL


-- test: logger show all including effective levels --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger --all
-- expect:regex --
LOGGER\s+LEVEL
-- expect:regex --
ROOT\s+INFO
-- expect:regex --
com\.example\.testapp\s+INFO
-- expect:regex --
\(effective\)


-- test: logger listing shows groups --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger
-- expect:regex --
GROUP\s+CONFIGURED\s+MEMBERS
-- expect:regex --
sql\s+-\s+org\.
-- expect:regex --
web\s+-\s+org\.springframework


-- test: set and reset a logger group level --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger web DEBUG
-- expect --
Logger "web" set to DEBUG
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger web
-- expect:regex --
web\s+DEBUG\s+org\.springframework
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger web RESET
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger
-- expect:regex --
web\s+-\s+org\.springframework


-- test: logger prefix filter matches groups --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger sql
-- expect:regex --
GROUP\s+CONFIGURED\s+MEMBERS
-- expect:regex --
sql\s+-\s+
-- expect:not --
web
